verdict.rationale: Steel publishes its browser API source in a public GitHub repo (steel-dev/steel-browser) that calls itself open-source and ships a self-hostable Docker image. The docs and homepage repeat the open-source positioning, and a community commenter independently notes it is open-source. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (e.g. Apache-2.0/MIT), and nothing clarifies whether managed-cloud features such as CAPTCHA solving, managed proxies and agent traces are in the open repo.
